sources.model.h100_sxm: NVIDIA H100 SXM datasheet: 132 SMs, 1830 MHz boost, 80GB HBM3, 3.35 TB/s
sources.link.nvlink: NVIDIA H100 SXM NVLink 4: 900 GB/s per GPU (aggregate bidirectional); latency 1 us is an ASSUMPTION, not a published figure
sources.link.ib: NDR InfiniBand 400 Gb/s = 50 GB/s per GPU NIC; latency 5 us is an ASSUMPTION, not a published figure
sources.link.ib.shared_group: null deliberately: an NDR node has EIGHT independent 400 Gb/s NICs, one per GPU, so each GPU sees its own 50 GB/s. Do NOT put all eight links in one shared_group -- that divides per-GPU bandwidth by 8 and was a measured 8x error in the first version of this spec (found by the gpu-sim-4jx magnitude derivation, 2026-10-22).
sources.assuming: the four switches / rail-optimised fabric are not modelled; cross-node bandwidth is per-GPU NIC bandwidth with no oversubscription
